### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/formula`, `@objectstack/service-automation`, touching **1** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/template.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-5.mdx`  _(via EvalContext (symbol, a top-level interface))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/template.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **14** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json b3ed6c86d46f96d15a2a70eab66ee411fe3b58e9` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `3faff829ae941baf49d25565102a545b0195916d` — the merge of head `2d2b09be7683ba4bcd1ab278a1c5f420653baac4` into base `b3ed6c86d46f96d15a2a70eab66ee411fe3b58e9`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 3faff829ae941baf49d25565102a545b0195916d && git checkout 3faff829ae941baf49d25565102a545b0195916d
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin b3ed6c86d46f96d15a2a70eab66ee411fe3b58e9 2d2b09be7683ba4bcd1ab278a1c5f420653baac4 && git checkout -B drift-repro b3ed6c86d46f96d15a2a70eab66ee411fe3b58e9 && git merge --no-ff 2d2b09be7683ba4bcd1ab278a1c5f420653baac4

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json b3ed6c86d46f96d15a2a70eab66ee411fe3b58e9
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs b3ed6c86d46f96d15a2a70eab66ee411fe3b58e9` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2d2b09be7683ba4bcd1ab278a1c5f420653baac4`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/formula/src/template-engine.ts, packages/formula/src/template-engine.test.ts, packages/formula/src/template-formatters.test.ts, packages/formula/src/types.ts, packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/template.ts, packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/text-slot-template.test.ts, scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/core.json, scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/react.json, ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts, ui/packages/core/src/actions/actionCopyTemplate.ts, ui/packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/ActionRunner.copyTemplateLocale-26232.test.ts, ui/packages/react/src/context/ActionContext.tsx, ui/packages/react/src/context/actionRunnerTranslator.ts, ui/packages/react/src/context/__tests__/ActionProvider.copyTemplateLocale-26232.test.tsx, ui/packages/react/src/hooks/useActionRunner.ts + packages/formula/src/stdlib.ts (buildScope), packages/formula/src/index.ts (EvalContext export), ui/packages/i18n/src/useDisplayLocale.ts, ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/bulkConfirmText.ts (fillTemplateHoles caller, at the merge base and at origin/main), packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/notify-node.ts, screen-nodes.ts, http-nodes.ts and src/node-text-rendering.ts (renderTextSlot callers), scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs, scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs, .github/workflows/pr-automation.yml (the job that runs it)

Inputs read: card #26232 body and all three comments (triage 6422123580, claim 6423821741, os-dev-report 6425204871); PR #26282 body, its 16-file list, and `git diff be531f68..2d2b09be` (16 files, 385+/20-, identical to the file list; the merge commit 9e83afb9 and the re-record 2d2b09be add no hunk beyond the two digest files); the head's check-runs, read 2026-10-26T20:02Z.

### ① Derived judgments

**The narrowing itself — right.** At the base, `template-engine.ts:276` read the formatter locale as `extra.locale`, then an undeclared `(ctx as { locale }).locale`, then `en-US`. At the head the only rung is the declared `EvalContext.locale` (`types.ts`), empty string falling to `en-US` exactly as the old `||` chain did. `buildScope` (`stdlib.ts:631`, read in full) copies `record`, `previous`, `input`, `user`/`org`/`env` and spreads `extra` at the scope root; it never binds `ctx.locale`, so the "reserved channel, not a variable" claim holds and a root named `locale` is exactly what `{{ locale }}` prints. Pinned three ways in `template-engine.test.ts` (context locale formats; root `locale` prints and does not format, alone and beside a context locale; unset or empty is `en-US`), and the PR's ablation (restore the `extra.locale` rung ahead of `ctx.locale`) reds the right pin. Expected strings are built with `Intl` in-test, so the pins are ICU-drift safe.

**Every caller of the template dialect, measured in the head tree — all accounted for, right.** Runtime producers of a `template`-dialect evaluate at the head are exactly two: `renderTextSlot` (service-automation `template.ts:119`, passes `{ extra: textTemplateScope(variables) }`, no locale) and `fillTemplateHoles` (ui core). Every other `.evaluate` reaches the engine through the registry with an authored expression, and a multi-line search of all 5,543 non-test `.ts`/`.tsx` sources under `packages/`, `ui/` and `apps/` for an `extra: { … locale … }` literal returns zero hits; the single-line forms (`extra.locale`, `extra?.locale`) return zero outside the new tests. The one caller that did set the locale through a root was `template-formatters.test.ts`; it is migrated to `locale: 'en-US'`. `formatValue` (`template-engine.ts:151`) takes `opts.locale` and is untouched. The PR body's caller census is therefore complete and accurate.

**Console wiring — right for the two paths it names.** `fillTemplateHoles(source, roots, locale?)` forwards `locale` on the context and keeps `extra: roots`. `ActionRunner` gains `displayLocale: (() … ) | null`, `setDisplayLocale(read)`, reads it per fill in `composeSuccessMessage` (line 1830) and `confirmMessage` (line 1869), and `scopedTo` (the `callContext` one-shot runner, line 2985) copies it beside the translator. Both React owners (`ActionProvider`, `useActionRunner`) install `useActionRunnerDisplayLocale()`, which wraps `useDisplayLocale()` (`ui/packages/i18n/src/useDisplayLocale.ts:64`, returns `locale || language || 'en'`, the one resolution) in the same latest-ref pattern as the translator; `@object-ui/i18n` already exports it (`index.ts:162`). Pinned at the runner (7 tests, incl. per-fill read and `callContext`) and through real `I18nProvider` + `LocalizationProvider` (4 tests, incl. a language switch reaching an already-built runner). The ruling's "no second copy of the locale resolution" is honoured.

**The third `fillTemplateHoles` caller — the card's headline symptom — is deliberately not wired, and the reason has since moved.** `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/bulkConfirmText.ts` at the merge base passes `{ count }` only (step 1 of #25942), so at the base no bulk param was a root at all. #26217 (the step-2 PR that binds the params' display values as roots via `bulkConfirmTemplateScope`) MERGED at 2026-10-26T19:54Z — after this head (19:30Z) and not an ancestor of it. On `origin/main` today a bulk param named `locale` therefore does reach `extra`; this PR's engine change closes that hijack the moment it lands, with no plugin-grid edit, which is the card's first symptom. The card's second symptom (the bulk confirm sentence formats in `en-US` for every viewer) stays open: `bulkConfirmText` still passes no third argument on `origin/main`. The PR named #26217 as the carrier; #26217 landed without it, so that carrier no longer exists — see ③.

**Public surface the diff implies, each named right.** Widening: `EvalContext.locale?` (exported from `@objectstack/formula` `index.ts:173`), `fillTemplateHoles` optional third argument and `ActionRunner.setDisplayLocale` (both `@object-ui/core`), `useActionRunnerDisplayLocale` (`@object-ui/react`). Narrowing: `extra.locale` is no longer read. Nothing removed or renamed. The sdui per-package digests (`scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/{core,react}.json`) move because `ui/packages/{core,react}/src` moved; `manifestSha256` is unchanged, matching an unchanged `sdui.manifest.json` (not in the diff), and the source counts (111 / 70) are unchanged, consistent with the two new files being tests outside the index.

**`Metadata-protocol: none` — right.** Nothing a metadata author writes is added, refused, renamed or re-shaped: `confirmText`, `successMessage`, `params`, flow variables and the hole grammar are untouched. The only "meaning" that changed is which input the engine's formatters take their locale from, and that rung was never an authored-protocol promise: ADR-0032 names locale threading as an open catalog item, `packages/spec/src/automation/flow-text-slot-template.ts` and `io-node-config.zod.ts` say nothing of a `locale` variable, and `content/docs` never documents it. The one place that did state it was a runtime JSDoc in service-automation `template.ts`, which the diff corrects. Triage 6422123580 reads the old rung as a hijack bug, not a protocol; `none` is the honest line and `semantic` would over-claim.

### ② Semver level

The changeset `.changeset/26232-template-locale-reserved-channel.md` bumps `@objectstack/formula`, `@objectstack/service-automation`, `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/react` at `patch`, carries both line-initial declarations (`Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`), a `**BREAKING** (a narrowing)` banner with the what-to-do, and exactly one ADR-0087 marker, `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. This is the shape AGENTS.md §3 prescribes for a non-protocol breaking change ("ships `patch` and keeps its BREAKING banner and ADR-0087 disposition"); a `minor` is owed only for a Metadata-protocol kind, which is `none` here. The four packages are the four the diff moves (service-automation moves by a doc-comment hunk only; a `patch` there is the conservative reading and the gate took it). The disposition's facts hold: no spec key, authorable spelling or stored shape moves, nothing for `objectstack migrate meta` to rewrite, every bumped package publishes, no registry id is named — and the gate that reads the arm and the marker against the merge base (`check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base`, run inside the `Check Changeset` job per `pr-automation.yml:998`) is `success` on this head, so the changeset's own prose was judged not to carry a migration prescription. The `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` line is right: surface grows (the widenings above) and one accepted input (`extra.locale`) stops being honoured, so it is BREAKING by definition and the dogfood battery it owes ran (`Dogfood Regression Gate` success). PR body and changeset declarations agree.

### ③ Boundary flags

The os-dev-report (6425204871) lists `open_questions: []` and two `out_of_scope_findings`; the PR body carries the same two as acceptance notes. Each answered:

1. **Bulk confirm dialog not wired to the display locale; carrier named as #26217 (open draft at report time).** Answered with an escalation: #26217 merged at 19:54Z without that argument, so the named carrier is gone and the card's second symptom (bulk confirm formats in `en-US` for every viewer) is now ownerless. Not a defect of this PR — its File surface was the engine channel and the console filler, and this PR's engine change does close the hijack half on today's `main` — but the seat owes a follow-up card (one argument: `useDisplayLocale()` into `fillTemplateHoles`'s third parameter in `bulkConfirmText`/`BulkActionDialog`), filed with the dedupe words the report gives, before #26232 is read as fully closed. Because #26217 is not in this head, the merge queue will build this PR against a `main` whose `bulkConfirmText.ts` moved; no path of this diff is touched by #26217, so no textual conflict is expected.
2. **Flow text slots (notify/screen/end/http via `renderTextSlot`) format in `en-US`; no flow-level locale channel.** Answered, accepted as out of scope: the card's "Who acts" is the evaluate context and the console filler; flow-level locale is a separate design (notify documents one text for every recipient, and `io-node-config.zod.ts` resolves the e-mail locale per recipient after fan-out). The corrected JSDoc in `template.ts` states the current behaviour truthfully.
3. **Dev flag: "CI: 0 check-runs at report time; NOT MEASURED: every CI family".** Answered by the head's check-runs at 2026-10-26T20:02Z: 23 `success` (incl. `Check Changeset`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Build UI Deps`, every `Lint ·` family, `Type Check · source gates`, the four claim/single-writer guards), 6 `skipped` opt-in or matrix placeholders, 0 failures; still `in_progress`: `Build Core`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Lint UI`, `Test Core (1–8/8)`, `Test UI (1–16/16)`, `Type Check UI`, `Type Check · workspace`, `Type Check · consumer gates`, `Type Check · debt ledger`. The dev's local run of the same families (formula 1427, service-automation 2699, core 4097, react 1483 tests; 80 dispatch-gate commands exit 0; full build; dogfood battery) is consistent with everything CI has finished. The verdict below stands on the families that have concluded; the queue guard will hold the PR on any family that turns red.
4. **Report head vs PR head.** The report and PR-body gate runs name `6507217d8`; the head is `2d2b09be` (a merge of `origin/main` plus the digest re-record). The net diff against the merge base is unchanged in substance (16 files, same hunks), so the report's measurements carry.
5. **No `packages/spec/**` touched; `EvalContext` lives in `packages/formula/src/types.ts`** and is not a spec type (the only `EvalContext` under `packages/spec/src` is a local interface in a test), so the claim's stop-condition was not triggered. Right.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-vqfv9q`
Reviewed-by: `session_0186vfjHHMsRXC9EUT9hTFMo`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 席位核对

**ACCEPT** · `domain:server` seat 2 · `os-project-manager` · `session_0186vfjHHMsRXC9EUT9hTFMo` · 2026-10-26T20:22Z · head `2d2b09be7683ba4bcd1ab278a1c5f420653baac4` · #26232

The maintainer's standing authorisation for landing reviewed PRs, verbatim: 「按照 pm-dispatch 规则复核过的都授权」.

1. **Shape:** a draft against `main` with `Fixes #26232`. `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are line-initial. The changesets are four `patch` entries (formula, service-automation, `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/react`) with a BREAKING banner and the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. `check-governed-merges --pr 26282`: NOT governed, 405 changed lines.
2. **Premise and review:** triage `6422123580` and the claim `6423821741` asked for a locale slot on the evaluate context, apart from the author-visible roots. The narrowing face is owed, so the contract review is the record of record: comment `6426083828` on this head, at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, read-only, **PASS**. It found three things. The engine reads only `EvalContext.locale`, empty still meaning `en-US`, and no scope binds it, so a root named `locale` is now only a printable value. A census of every non-test source finds no producer that set the locale through a root, and the one test that did was migrated. The console's runners install `useDisplayLocale()` through `ActionRunner.setDisplayLocale`, read on each fill, with no second locale resolution. The head is the dev's merge of `main` (`9e83afb99`) plus the two `sdui-manifest` sources regenerated with `gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`, and `check-sdui-manifest` exits 0.
3. **Gates:** at this stamp the head's 62 check-runs read 56 success and 6 skipped (docs-build and opt-in harnesses), with none failing or in progress; this includes the full UI matrix (`Test UI` 1–16, `Build & E2E UI`, `Lint UI`, `Type Check UI`), `Check Changeset` (which runs the ADR-0087 registration gate) and the `Dogfood Regression Gate` the narrowing arm owes. Mergeable, clean. Locally the dev reports 78 of 78 derived gate families run and exit 0 after the merge, reconciled with `--ran`.
4. **Accepted deviations:** the docs-drift bot lists `content/docs/releases/v17/17-5.mdx` as naming `EvalContext`. That page is release-owned and read-only, and it is not edited here.
5. **Out of scope:** the bulk confirm dialog still formats in `en-US`. PR #26217 was to carry the one-argument wiring and merged without it. The remainder is filed as #26307, blocked by this PR.
6. **Landing:** this seat runs `pr_ready` and then `automerge_enable` through the relay, confirms MERGED on both readings, and records the landing on #26232, which the merge closes.
